title: Augmented Inverse Hybrid Weighting: Robust Inference under Deterministic and Random Distribution Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2608.00701v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reweighting source samples to match a target covariate distribution is a standard response to distribution shift when generalizing evidence across populations. It is well suited to deterministic, learnable covariate discrepancies, but can fail when source--target differences extend beyond covariate shift or when estimation of the density-ratio weights is unstable. We introduce a new model where the discrepancy between two population laws comprises a deterministic covariate shift and a non-systematic component, modeled as random perturbation of the probability space. This separates systematic shifts, treated as bias and corrected by reweighting, from random perturbations, treated as distributional uncertainty and reduced by dataset pooling. Under pure random perturbations, this principle yields Augmented Inverse Distance Weighting, which combines regression augmentation with variance-optimal dataset-level pooling and attains asy

translated_title: 增强逆混合加权：确定性与随机分布偏移下的稳健推断
translated_abstract: 对源样本重新加权以匹配目标协变量分布，是在跨人群推广证据时应对分布偏移的标准方法。该方法非常适合确定性的、可学习的协变量差异，但当源与目标之间的差异超出协变量偏移的范围，或密度比权重的估计不稳定时，该方法可能会失效。我们引入了一个新的模型，其中两个总体分布律之间的差异由一个确定性协变量偏移和一个非系统性成分组成，后者被建模为概率空间上的随机扰动。这一框架将系统性偏移（被视为偏差，通过重新加权加以校正）与随机扰动（被视为分布不确定性，通过数据集合并加以降低）区分开来。在纯随机扰动的情形下，该原理导出了增强逆距离加权方法，该方法将回归增强与方差最优的数据集层面合并相结合，并获得了渐近（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将分布偏移分解为可通过重加权校正的确定性协变量偏移和可通过数据集合并降低的随机扰动这一新模型，并由此导出增强逆距离加权方法，实现了在确定性与随机分布偏移下更稳健的跨人群统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel hybrid weighting model that decomposes distribution shift into deterministic covariate shift (corrected via reweighting) and random perturbation (mitigated via dataset pooling), yielding Augmented Inverse Distance Weighting for robust inference under both deterministic and random distribution shifts.
